# Sarth Calhoun

https://www.sarth.net/

Brooklyn. Musician, software, artist. Founded Third Wall Studio (May 2025) and The (Gr)album Collective (Book of Sarth, 2012). Visual Reference Prompting is a core practice. Burlap is the flagship machine, used at Third Wall Studio.

Metal Machine Trio is an equal collaboration: Sarth Calhoun, Lou Reed, Ulrich Krieger. The Creation of the Universe is the REDCAT nights, 2–3 Oct 2008.

Lulu: original score composed with Lou Reed for Robert Wilson’s Berliner Ensemble production (premiere 12 Apr 2011). Then composed and performed on the Lou Reed & Metallica album. Wilson first. Metallica second.

Junior Dad grew from the first session at Lou’s apartment: Rob Wasserman bowing electric upright, Sarth processing through Kyma.

X: https://x.com/noisegroove
GitHub: https://github.com/whiddershins
